name: crypto_market

name: defi_analytics
description: DeFiLlama DeFi data: TVL rankings, protocol details, chain stats, protocol fees/revenue, yield pools, stablecoin market caps.

name: dex_market
description: DexScreener DEX data: search pairs/tokens, get specific pair info, token details by address, trending token boosts.

name: sentiment_index
description: Crypto Fear & Greed Index: current value, historical data, and real-time granular readings.

name: tradfi_news
description: Finnhub financial data: earnings calendar, general/crypto news, company profiles. Requires FINNHUB_API_KEY.

name: crypto_price
description: FreeCrypto: crypto price data and symbol list (100K req/month free).

name: social_trending
description: Social media trending lists: Douyin, Weibo, Bilibili, Zhihu, Baidu, GitHub, Toutiao, 36Kr, CSDN, and more. Three-provider failover.

name: network_status
description: On-chain public data (no API key): ETH gas prices, BTC recommended fees, mempool stats, and recent blocks.

name: derivatives_sentiment
description: Social sentiment data: Reddit crypto trending (ApeWisdom), Binance futures long/short ratios, open interest history, taker buy/sell ratio.

name: global_data
description: World data: forex exchange rates (150+ currencies), weather forecast, Wikipedia article summaries, arXiv paper search.

name: news_feed
description: Aggregate news from 44 RSS/Atom feeds: crypto, macro, tech, geopolitics, science. Filter by keyword. No API key required.

name: cn_market
description: A-share and HK stock data via AKShare: OHLCV history, current price, symbol search, index daily data.

name: global_assets
description: Yahoo Finance data: OHLCV history and current price for stocks, ETFs, crypto (BTC-USD), forex (EURUSD=X), futures (GC=F). No API key.

name: crypto_derivatives
description: Crypto market data via ccxt exchange. Covers: price, klines (OHLCV), 24h ticker, multi-symbol price.

name: technical_analysis
description: Technical analysis on crypto pairs: RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, MA/EMA, ATR, support/resistance levels, full composite analysis, and batch analysis for multiple symbols.

name: backtest
description: Run historical backtests on trading strategies using VectorBT. Fetches OHLCV from exchange (ccxt), computes indicators (RSI/MACD/BB/EMA/ATR), evaluates entry/exit signals, simulates portfolio, returns

name: macro_indicators
description: Macro economic calendar and indicators: CPI, Non-Farm Payrolls, FOMC decisions, GDP growth, unemployment, retail sales, PPI, ISM PMI, and more. Data from FRED (Federal Reserve). Set FRED_API_KEY for h

name: rates_yields
description: US interest rates and bond yields: Treasury yield curve (3M/1Y/2Y/5Y/10Y/30Y), Federal funds rate and target bands, SOFR, mortgage rates, credit spreads, 10Y-2Y spread (recession indicator), breakeven

name: cross_asset
description: Rolling cross-asset correlation: BTC vs Gold, DXY, Nasdaq, S&P500, 10Y Treasury yield, EUR/USD, oil, VIX, and any other Yahoo Finance symbol. Returns Pearson correlation (full period + rolling window)
